Name: Average Customer Lifespan
Expression:
AVERAGEX(
    VALUES(DIM_Customers[CustomerID]),
    DATEDIFF(
        CALCULATE([First Purchase Date]),
        CALCULATE(MAX(DIM_Orders[OrderDate]),ALL(Calender[Date])),
        DAY
    )
)/30

Name: Delivery Days
Expression:
VAR delivary_time_Table1 = CALCULATETABLE(DIM_Orders,DIM_Orders[Delivary_Status] = "Delivered")

VAR Result = AVERAGEX(delivary_time_Table1,[Delivery_Time])
RETURN
Result
Description: Average number of days taken to deliver an order, calculated across all orders with Delivery_Status = Delivered.

Name: Order_Per_Customers
Expression:
VAR Total_ = [Total_Orders_ALL]
VAR CUS = [Total Customers]
VAR Result = DIVIDE(Total_,CUS)

RETURN
Result
Description: Average number of orders placed per customer across all order statuses, including undelivered orders (Total_Orders_ALL / Total Customers).

Name: Purchase Frequency
Expression: DIVIDE(DISTINCTCOUNT(DIM_Orders[OrderNumber]),DISTINCTCOUNT(DIM_Orders[CustomerID]))
Description: Average number of orders placed per unique customer (Total Orders / Total Customers), measuring purchase frequency.

Name: AOV
Expression: DIVIDE([Total Revenue],[Total Orders])
Description: Average order value for delivered orders (Total Revenue / Total Orders).

Name: Avg. Revenue per customer
Expression: DIVIDE([Total Revenue],[Total Customers])
Description: Average revenue generated per unique customer in the selected period (Total Revenue / Total Customers).

Name: %_of_paramiter
Expression:
VAR Rank_Base = SELECTEDVALUE(ParameterMAIN[Parameter Order])

VAR Ravenue = CALCULATE([Total Revenue],ALL(DIM_Customers))
VAR Cogs = CALCULATE([Total COGS], ALLSELECTED(DIM_Customers[CustomerID]))
VAR Profit = CALCULATE([Total Profit], ALLSELECTED(DIM_Customers[CustomerID]))
VAR Unit = CALCULATE([Total Units], ALLSELECTED(DIM_Customers[CustomerID]))


VAR t = [Total Revenue]/Ravenue
VAR Cumulative_Paramiter = SWITCH(TRUE(),Rank_Base = 0 ,[Total Revenue]/Ravenue
                                        ,Rank_Base = 1 , [Total COGS]/Cogs
                                        ,Rank_Base = 2 , [Total Profit]/Profit
                                        ,Rank_Base = 3 , [Total Units]/Unit)
                                        
RETURN
Cumulative_Paramiter
Description: Calculates each customer's percentage share of the selected KPI total (Revenue, COGS, Profit, or Units) based on the ParameterMAIN slicer. Used as the contribution metric in the customer ranking and data label measures.

Name: COGS% of Revenue
Expression: DIVIDE([Total COGS],[Total Revenue],BLANK())
Description: Cost of goods sold expressed as a percentage of total revenue, reflecting the proportion of sales consumed by direct costs.

Name: Total_Orders_ALL
Expression: CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(DIM_Orders[OrderNumber]))
Description: Count of all distinct orders regardless of delivery status, used as the denominator in order-per-customer calculations.

Name: Customer_Count
Expression: CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Customer Order Distribution'),USERELATIONSHIP(Calender[Date],'Customer Order Distribution'[First_Purchease_Date]))
Description: Count of customers by their first purchase date, linked via the Customer Order Distribution table using the First_Purchase_Date relationship. Used to plot new customer acquisition trends on a date axis.

Name: New Customers
Expression:
VAR CustomerFirstPurchase = ADDCOLUMNS(SUMMARIZE(
        DIM_Orders,
        DIM_Orders[CustomerID]),
        "FirstPurchase", [First Purchase Date])
VAR Result_ = COUNTROWS(FILTER(CustomerFirstPurchase,[FirstPurchase] >= MIN(Calender[Date]) && [FirstPurchase] <= MAX(Calender[Date])
            ))
RETURN Result_
Description: Count of customers whose very first purchase date falls within the selected period, identifying net-new buyers.

Name: Total Customers
Expression: DISTINCTCOUNT(DIM_Orders[CustomerID])
Description: Count of distinct customers who placed at least one order in the selected period (source: DIM_Orders[CustomerID]).

Name: Total Orders
Expression: CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(DIM_Orders[OrderNumber]),DIM_Orders[Delivary_Status] = "Delivered")
Description: Count of distinct delivered orders in the selected period (filters DIM_Orders where Delivery_Status = Delivered).

Name: Total Online Orders

Description: Count of distinct orders with Delivery_Status = Delivered in the selected period, representing fulfilled online orders.

Name: MOM % Cogs
Expression:
VAR LATESTPERIOD = LASTDATE(Calender[Start of month])


    VAR CURRENTMONTHSTART = CALCULATE(MIN(Calender[Date]), Calender[Start of month] = LATESTPERIOD)


    VAR PreviousMonthSales = 
        CALCULATE( 
            [Total COGS], 
            ALL(Calender[Start of month]),
            DATESBETWEEN(Calender[Date], 
                EOMONTH(CURRENTMONTHSTART,-2) + 1, 
                EOMONTH(CURRENTMONTHSTART,-1)
            )
        )

    VAR curretMonthSales =  
        CALCULATE( 
            [Total COGS], 
            ALL(Calender[Start of month]),
            DATESBETWEEN(Calender[Date], 
                EOMONTH(CURRENTMONTHSTART,-1) + 1, 
                EOMONTH(LATESTPERIOD,0)
            )
        )

    VAR Result = 
        IF( PreviousMonthSales > 0 ,
            DIVIDE((curretMonthSales - PreviousMonthSales), PreviousMonthSales , BLANK()), BLANK())
        
    
    
    RETURN
     Result
Description: Month-over-month percentage change in COGS, comparing the latest full month to the immediately preceding month.

Name: Customer_Rank
Expression:
VAR Rank_Base = SELECTEDVALUE(ParameterMAIN[Parameter Order])
VAR Ranking_number = Parameter_CUS_NUMBER[Parameter Value]

VAR Rank_Revenue = CALCULATE(RANKX(ALLSELECTED(DIM_Customers[CustomerID]),[Total Revenue],,DESC,Dense),USERELATIONSHIP('Customer Order Distribution'[CustomerID],DIM_Customers[CustomerID]))
VAR Rank_Cogs = CALCULATE(RANKX(ALLSELECTED(DIM_Customers[CustomerID]),[Total COGS],,DESC,Dense),USERELATIONSHIP('Customer Order Distribution'[CustomerID],DIM_Customers[CustomerID]))
VAR Rank_Profit = CALCULATE(RANKX(ALLSELECTED(DIM_Customers[CustomerID]),[Total Profit],,DESC,Dense),USERELATIONSHIP('Customer Order Distribution'[CustomerID],DIM_Customers[CustomerID]))
VAR Rank_Unit = CALCULATE(RANKX(ALLSELECTED(DIM_Customers[CustomerID]),[Total Units],,DESC,Dense),USERELATIONSHIP('Customer Order Distribution'[CustomerID],DIM_Customers[CustomerID]))

VAR Ranking = SWITCH(TRUE(),Rank_Base = 0, Rank_Revenue
                            ,Rank_Base = 1, Rank_Cogs
                            ,Rank_Base = 2, Rank_Profit
                            ,Rank_Base = 3, Rank_Unit)

VAR Result_ = SWITCH(TRUE(),Ranking <= Parameter_CUS_NUMBER[Parameter Value] && Rank_Base = 0, [Total Revenue]
                        ,Ranking <= Parameter_CUS_NUMBER[Parameter Value] && Rank_Base = 1, [Total COGS]
                        ,Ranking <= Parameter_CUS_NUMBER[Parameter Value] && Rank_Base = 2, [Total Profit]
                        ,Ranking <= Parameter_CUS_NUMBER[Parameter Value] && Rank_Base = 3, [Total Units])

RETURN
Result_
Description: Ranks customers by Revenue, COGS, Profit, or Units (dense rank, descending) based on the ParameterMAIN slicer, using the Customer Order Distribution table relationship. Returns the selected KPI value only for customers within the top N threshold set by the Parameter_CUS_NUMBER slicer.
